summary: Updates the fast reroute procedures of RFC 4090 so they work for co-routed associated bidirectional Label Switched Paths, where two one-way paths are bound together with RSVP association signaling. It covers both single-sided and double-sided provisioning. It is a standards-track document.

eli5.summary: Two one-way roads can be paired up to act like one two-way road. If a road is blocked, this document explains how traffic quickly switches to a detour while both directions keep using the same route.
